tasks.title: WhatsApp customer-service dashboard: exact response times and conversation volume
tasks.brief: Ahmed: build an in-app dashboard (inside NOVA Rx, Black Edition Arabic RTL, opened from the conversations screen and/or reports; same PIN gate as the old chats, PIN-gated staging endpoint under /api/v1/inbox/history/ style, read-only, no customer data in the public artifact) showing EXACTLY how long we take to reply to customers, from the imported WhatsApp history in staging D1 (26 chats/561 msgs from the bot log; senders user/bot/pharm/sys; note live forwarder timestamps are in seconds not ms, normalize). Metrics: first response time and every reply time per customer message, split bot vs pharmacist (human) — exact minutes/seconds; median, average, p90, slowest; % replied within 1/5/15/60 min; unanswered customer messages and waiting-now list; time from bot handoff (اتحوّل للصيدلي) to pharmacist reply. Volume: number of customers who wrote (unique), new vs returning, conversations and messages per day/hour, busiest hours heatmap, top topics if simple (keyword based). Filters: date range, today/7d/30d, bot vs pharmacist. Each metric clickable to the chats behind it. Charts smooth, design top priority. Tests for the metric calculations (exact times, timezone Africa/Cairo display, seconds-vs-ms normalization). Build into the next worker/live artifact (next free name, tools/build-worker-artifact.mjs, markers test, node --check). No deploy.
tasks.acceptance: Dashboard shows exact reply times (bot and pharmacist) and how many customers write, with filters; PIN-gated; tests pass; artifact built; no deploy.
